summary: Current source makes native textareas auto-grow by default and adds complete declarative modal, image-lightbox and anchored-help examples with inherited effects after the published 2.0.0 release. Scrollable overlays and desktop app-shell sidebars also reserve stable classic-scrollbar space; local data-table-sticky wrappers add optional header/column pinning. Native autofill also receives an automatic theme-aware border while retaining browser colours. Tables now default to row feedback with local cell/column/none overrides. An optional native CSS reading-progress extension now supplies decorative page-scroll position. Browser/device and final release validation are deferred by maintainer instruction until the planned 2.0.1 review. Published 2.0.0 downloads remain unchanged; source builds do not inherit their acceptance. On 16 October 2026 the maintainer reported manually testing all additions through reading progress across browsers successfully; browser versions and detailed accessibility/preference evidence were not supplied. New default themed scrollbars with auto/thin/native modes are implemented after that attestation and await their own browser/device review. The maintainer subsequently reported all manual/browser checks through accent scrollbars passed on 16 October 2026. New optional hero and gradient effects follow that attestation and require fresh acceptance.
